reforms.description: Japan aims to enhance public support for business R&D, which has been below the OECD average and has decreased in recent years. The reform focuses on increasing the use of direct grants targeting specific objectives to promote R&D spending effectively.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Increasing public support for R&D is expected to stimulate private sector investment and innovation, leading to higher productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has announced plans to enhance public support for business R&D.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant shift in Japan's approach to R&D funding, aiming to align public support with private sector needs and enhance overall innovation capacity.
reforms.source_quote: Public support to business R&D is below the OECD average and has decreased markedly in recent years.

reforms.description: The government is focusing on boosting the innovation potential of universities by enhancing their links with businesses, particularly SMEs, to foster creative innovation and increase the share of business-financed R&D performed at universities.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By improving collaboration between universities and businesses, the reform is expected to enhance knowledge transfer and innovation, leading to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has announced plans to enhance the role of universities in innovation.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative is significant as it aims to bridge the gap between academia and industry, which is crucial for fostering innovation in Japan.
reforms.source_quote: Enhancing the role of universities and public research institutions by strengthening their links with businesses, especially SMEs, could help fulfil the government’s objective to boost creative innovation.

reforms.description: The government plans to make the R&D tax credit refundable or reinstate the tax carry-over to enhance incentives for innovative start-ups and early-stage SMEs.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By improving the effectiveness of the R&D tax credit, the reform aims to stimulate investment in innovation among start-ups and SMEs, which can lead to increased productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government plans to make the R&D tax credit refundable or reinstate the tax carry-over.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant change in the R&D tax credit system, which is crucial for enhancing innovation capacity among SMEs and start-ups, thereby addressing broader economic challenges.
reforms.source_quote: Make the R&D tax credit refundable or reinstate the tax carry-over to enhance incentives to invest by innovative start-ups and early-stage SMEs.

reforms.description: The government introduced the Five-year Start-up Development Plan, aiming to increase start-up investment significantly and create a substantial number of unicorns and start-ups.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The plan is designed to enhance the start-up ecosystem, which can lead to increased innovation and economic growth through new business creation.
reforms.status_evidence: The government allocated JPY 1 trillion to the plan in the FY2022 supplementary budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative represents a significant structural change in Japan's approach to fostering innovation and entrepreneurship, with potential long-term impacts on the economy.
reforms.source_quote: The Five-year Start-up Development Plan, introduced in November 2022, set a goal of increasing start-up investment by more than tenfold (to JPY 10 trillion) by FY2027.

reforms.description: The November 2023 economic package includes stronger tax incentives for businesses to achieve structural wage increases, regulatory reforms, and R&D financing to generate new frontiers of growth in space and oceans.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The package aims to stimulate business investment in R&D and innovation, which can enhance productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The economic package was launched with specific measures to support R&D financing.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant shift in policy aimed at enhancing R&D and innovation capabilities, which are critical for long-term economic growth.
reforms.source_quote: The November 2023 economic package includes stronger tax incentives for businesses to achieve structural wage increases, regulatory reforms and R&D financing to generate new frontiers of growth in space and oceans.

reforms.description: Fukuoka City has established a Startup Support Hub, which provides integrated services for startups, including a startup visa programme and special corporate tax reductions.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The initiative aims to foster a vibrant startup ecosystem, which can enhance innovation and economic growth by supporting new business ventures.
reforms.status_evidence: Fukuoka City has a Startup Support Hub that offers various services to startups.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of the Startup Support Hub represents a significant effort to enhance the startup ecosystem in Fukuoka, which can lead to increased innovation and economic activity.
reforms.source_quote: Designated a National Strategic Special Zone for Global Startups and Job Creation in 2014, Fukuoka City has a Startup Support Hub, which offers integrated startup support services, a startup visa programme and special corporate tax reductions for startups.

reforms.description: The Japan Patent Office has introduced model contracts to assist R&D start-ups and businesses in navigating joint research and licensing agreements.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By facilitating better communication and legal navigation for startups, this initiative can enhance the commercialization of innovative products and technologies.
reforms.status_evidence: The Japan Patent Office has thus set up model contracts helping R&D start-ups and business companies to improve their communication and successfully navigate the legal and negotiating hurdles of joint research and licence agreements.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative is significant as it addresses a critical barrier for startups in the commercialization process, potentially leading to increased innovation and economic activity.
reforms.source_quote: To better support open innovation, the Japan Patent Office has thus set up model contracts helping R&D start-ups and business companies to improve their communication and successfully navigate the legal and negotiating hurdles of joint research and licence agreements.

reforms.description: The University Endowment Fund, launched in March 2022, aims to provide selected universities with stable long-term funding to upgrade their research infrastructure and support university start-ups.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The fund enhances research capabilities and supports the creation of start-ups, fostering innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The fund is currently operational and providing support.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative represents a significant structural change in funding for universities, aiming to enhance their research capabilities and support innovation ecosystems.
reforms.source_quote: The University Endowment Fund, launched in March 2022 and with a current allocation of about JPY 10 trillion, is set to use the gains from the investment of the fund’s assets to provide selected universities with stable long-term funding.

reforms.description: The government plans to reform the collateral system to improve financing conditions for start-ups by allowing new lending to be secured by the entirety of a business's assets.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By easing collateral requirements, the reform aims to facilitate access to finance for innovative start-ups, thereby promoting entrepreneurship and economic dynamism.
reforms.status_evidence: The government aims to submit new legislation to introduce the possibility of incorporating intangible assets into collateral.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform addresses a critical barrier to start-up financing, potentially enhancing the entrepreneurial landscape in Japan.
reforms.source_quote: Government plans to reform the collateral system, which will improve financing conditions for start-ups with growth potential, are welcome.

reforms.description: The national research and development authority (NEDO) will spend JPY 20 billion per year (until 2027) to subsidise two thirds of R&D start-ups’ costs of practical application development, provided the remaining third is funded through (certified) venture capital investment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This funding aims to enhance R&D capabilities in start-ups, fostering innovation and productivity growth in the economy.
reforms.status_evidence: The NEDO has announced the allocation of funds for R&D start-ups.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant investment in R&D funding for start-ups, which is crucial for driving innovation and economic growth.
reforms.source_quote: The national research and development authority (NEDO) will spend JPY 20 billion per year (until 2027) to subsidise two thirds of R&D start-ups’ costs of practical application development.

reforms.description: As of April 2023, companies can deduct 25% of the value of an equity investment in start-ups from their corporate tax liabilities, enhancing incentives for investment in innovative firms.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This tax incentive is designed to stimulate private investment in start-ups, which can lead to increased innovation and economic activity.
reforms.status_evidence: Companies can now benefit from the new tax deduction for equity investments in start-ups.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform provides a significant incentive for private sector investment in innovation, which is essential for fostering a vibrant start-up ecosystem.
reforms.source_quote: As of April 2023, companies can deduct 25% of the value of an equity investment in start-ups from their corporate tax liabilities.

reforms.description: The government established the Children and Families Agency to consolidate child-related policies and enhance support for families, including financial assistance and improved childcare services.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By improving financial support and childcare services, the initiative aims to enhance the well-being of families, which can lead to increased fertility and a more stable workforce.
reforms.status_evidence: The Children and Families Agency was established and began operations in April 2023.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant structural change in how child-related policies are managed and implemented, aiming to address long-standing issues related to family support and fertility rates.
reforms.source_quote: The government established the Children and Families Agency on 1 April 2023 by combining offices responsible for child-related policy across the government into one organisation.

reforms.description: Japan launched the Specified Skilled Worker Programme in April 2019, allowing medium-skilled foreign workers to be employed on working visas in sectors facing labor shortages, marking a significant shift from previous trainee-based employment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By attracting skilled foreign workers, the programme aims to alleviate labor shortages and enhance productivity in key sectors, contributing positively to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The programme has been operational since April 2019.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a structural change in Japan's labor policy, addressing critical labor shortages and enhancing the country's ability to attract foreign talent, which is essential for economic sustainability.
reforms.source_quote: In April 2019, Japan launched the Specified Skilled Worker Programme, a new residency status for work-ready foreigners with expertise in 14 business lines facing labour shortages.

reforms.description: Reforms to improve the innovation framework and incentives for start-ups are key to boost productivity and address ageing pressures.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing the innovation framework and start-up incentives is expected to increase productivity, which can lead to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Reforms to improve the innovation framework and incentives for start-ups are key to boost productivity.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform addresses systemic issues in the innovation ecosystem, which is crucial for long-term economic resilience and productivity growth.
reforms.source_quote: Reforms to improve the innovation framework and incentives for start-ups are key to boost productivity and address ageing pressures.
